name: Carnegie Skills Progressions
summary: Progressions for three durable skills (collaboration, communication and critical thinking), each with subskills, indicators and four levels from Exploring to Extending.

license.note: Learning Commons distributes it under CC BY 4.0, crediting the Carnegie Foundation. The Carnegie Foundation and ETS report it comes from says "All Rights Reserved" on every page, and neither states CC BY on its own pages.

access_note: In the Knowledge Graph's open files and its REST API (API key). The report itself is a free PDF from the Carnegie Foundation.
made_by: Carnegie Foundation for the Advancement of Teaching
cite: Carnegie Foundation for the Advancement of Teaching and ETS (2026). Skills Progressions, Vol. 1: Collaboration, Communication, Critical Thinking.

fits.how: An activity can aim at a skill and a level instead of a standard; the harness carries its own copy.
